ReviewerInvite.title: ReviewerInvite
ReviewerInvite.description: Represents an invitation sent to a potential reviewer.

AdminInvite.title: AdminInvite
AdminInvite.description: Represents an invitation sent to a potential administrator.

School.title: School
School.description: Represents a tenant in the multi-tenant SaaS application, corresponding to an educational institution.

id.description: Unique identifier for the School entity.

name.description: The official name of the school or institution.

logoUrl.description: URL to the school's logo, displayed in their portal.

customDomain.description: Optional custom domain for the school's dedicated portal access.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the school record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the school record was last updated.

User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user account within the system, belonging to a specific school and having a designated role.

id.description: Unique identifier for the User entity.

schoolId.description: Reference to the School this user belongs to. (Relationship: School 1:N User)

email.description: The user's email address, used for login and notifications.

role.description: The role of the user within the system (e.g., 'Applicant', 'Admin', 'Reviewer').

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the user account was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the user account was last updated.
